analyst.summary: DOMS Industries continues to grow revenue at a strong pace (both stationery and exports), backed by a clean, low-debt balance sheet. However, profit margins have compressed for two quarters running due to raw material cost pressure and product mix, so profit is now growing slightly slower than revenue rather than faster. At a very high valuation (~59 times earnings), the price already assumes both continued strong growth and a return to margin expansion neither of which is guaranteed. We rate this a Hold: an excellent business, priced for a best-case outcome.
